proposal.summary: R7 checks the round 96 Q3 and Q4 leads from the code, plus the numbered empty stubs of both firmwares. Four CM550 functions are proven twins of CM848 functions and take one shared unprefixed name in both firmwares. 0x143b6 is calculateJ1939PercentPeakTorquePoints, 0x1c640 is updateFourDimensionalFueling, 0x17b8a is selectCrankExitSpeed and 0xfa06 is setJ1939TorqueCurvePoint1AtDeratedIdleFueling. 0xfb26 (the PGN 65251 torque curve builder) and 0x17a8e (the crank initial fuel by coolant temperature) have the CM848 function's role but different code, so they are counterparts with cm550_ names. The four TPU channel 0 / 1 routines of the engine position inputs are named from their set-up branch and their TPU parameter use: the cam sync type 2 set-up, the cylinder identification pulse interrupt handler, the configuration 2 missing tooth sync error handler and configuration 0's speed measurement step. CM550 0x23be8 is the lamp driver feedback fault check and CM848 0x1d9b8 (same old name) is the fault handler's periodic pass: neither is the other's twin, so both take a prefix. Each empty stub is named by its one call site, and CM848 0x55e9c is named by its 23 TPU handler table entries. The cbd names in CM848 become cylinder balance names. The CM550 projection words 0x8002ac-0x8002c3 are one signed six-entry array, searched for the largest entry to pick the trim index. The five stale CM550 PGN 61184 read service members parse their requests exactly like CM848's handlers and take CM848's member names. Member 0x41 takes CM848's name too.

functions.role: Calculates the J1939 (Jcomm) percent peak torque x 256 at the idle, rated and breakpoint 3 / 4 / 5 engine speeds (e2m block 10E2).
functions.discriminator: The only caller of the two shared helpers. It first stores the coolant friction correction and refreshes the five friction fuels, then runs calculateJ1939PercentPeakTorqueAtSpeed five times (speed, friction fuel) into the five 10E2 percent torque words.
functions.plate_comment: Calculates the J1939 (Jcomm) percent peak torque x 256 at five engine speeds, e2m block 10E2. It stores the coolant temperature friction correction (friction_fuel_correction_by_coolant_temperature_lookup at the filtered coolant temperature) in friction_fuel_coolant_temperature_correction and refreshes the friction fuels with calculateJ1939FrictionLoadFuelingAtBreakpoints. It then runs calculateJ1939PercentPeakTorqueAtSpeed for the idle speed (lsg_breakpoint_speed), the rated speed and speed breakpoints 3 / 4 / 5 into JCLSPCTQ / JCRTPCTQ / JCPCTQ03-05 (10E2 +A / +C / +4 / +6 / +8). Its one caller is the J1708 message builder cm550_diagnosticMessage46Builder (jsr at 0x1f352). Twin of CM848 0x1820c (one shared name), which has no caller. (was cm550_multiSpeedParameterInterpolation; PR #53 round 97)

functions.role: TPU channel 1 interrupt handler for cam sync type 1. It decodes the cylinder identification (CI) pulse width as the number of engine position sensor teeth seen during the pulse. From that it sets the cam and crank sync states and debounces the sync faults.
functions.discriminator: The only channel 1 handler that reads the CI tooth count (channel 1 parameter 5, CMSNTTCU) and compares it with the wide and narrow CI counts (CMSNCU01 / CMSNCU02). It also checks the EPS tooth counter against the expected position (EGPSCU01 / EGPICU02). Its siblings 0x1b30a (type 0) and 0x1b4b2 (type 2) capture a period or only reset the measurement. There is no duty cycle monitor in it.
functions.plate_comment: TPU channel 1 interrupt handler for cam sync type 1 (EPCMSYTY = 1), installed by mc68k_initializeTpuChannel1BackupSpeedInput (it ends in RTE). It takes the number of EPS teeth during the cylinder identification (CI) pulse, CMSNTTCU (e2m 11C9 +0), from the low byte of channel 1 parameter 5, clears parameter 4 and reloads the CI timeout counter 0x80d2c2 from CMSNTMCU. A wide pulse (CMSNCU01) or a narrow pulse (CMSNCU02) is checked against the EPS tooth counter EGPITTCU (0x80ccea): at the expected position (EGPSCU01 / EGPICU02) it sets the cam and crank sync states CMSYSS / CRSYSS to 1 and counts the crank tooth count error CKTTCUER down. Otherwise it sets them to 2 (lost sync), resynchronizes EGPITTCU and counts CKTTCUER up to CKTTERMX, which sets status word 0 bit 0 and word 2 bit 0x800. A pulse of neither width counts CMSNCUER up to CMSNERMX, which sets word 0 bit 0. Last it calls mc68k_resetSpeedMeasurementMode0 and cm550_emptyBackupSpeedInterruptStep and clears channel 1's interrupt status bit. Not in effect in the dump (EPCMSYTY = 0). (was mc68k_dutyCycleMonitorIsrHandler; PR #53 round 97)

functions.role: On entry to CRANKING or REENTRY it sets the crank initial fuel and the crank initial fuel break speed by interpolating between the low and high coolant temperature points.
functions.discriminator: First step of cm550_engineModeTransitionHandler. It is the only writer of CKIIFL (0x80d0a6) and CKIIFLES (0x80d0b2), and it uses coolant temperature, where its sibling 0x17baa uses intake manifold temperature and sets timing. Nothing in it concerns frictional load torque.
functions.plate_comment: Crank initial fuel on entry to CRANKING or REENTRY (first call of cm550_engineModeTransitionHandler, before cm550_calculateCrankInitialAdvanceByIntakeManifoldTemperature). It sets crank_initial_fuel CKIIFL (0x80d0a6, e2m 105E +E) and crank_initial_fuel_break_speed_0_1000 CKIIFLES (105E +1A). They are interpolated by the filtered coolant temperature between CKCDCLTP (105F +4) and CKHTCLTP (105F +2), from the low / high temperature fuelings CKCDCLFL / CKHTCLFL and speeds CKCDCLES / CKHTCLES. With status word 2 bit 0 or 1 set and enabled in fault_processing_enable_flags[2], or below the low point, it takes the low values; above the high point it takes the high values. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_calculateColdStartTemperatureTable (0x1bc30), which uses a coolant x barometric pressure table with overrides and defaults instead. (was cm550_frictionalLoadTorqueInterpolator; PR #53 round 97)

functions.role: Builds the five speed / fueling points and indicated percent torques of the PGN 65251 engine configuration torque curve.
functions.discriminator: The only caller of the point 1 / 3 helpers through an 8-case table. The case index is +4 when the LSG base reference is outside the band, +2 for the derate fuel source 15 / 16, +1 for HSG reference states 1 / 2 / 4 / 5. Then it computes JCINISTQ.. from (fueling - CLNTFL) x 25600 / (JCRFEGFL - CLNTFL). It accumulates no statistics and has no VP44 access.
functions.plate_comment: Builds the J1939 engine configuration torque curve of PGN 65251 (e2m 1102) for buildPgn65251EngineConfiguration1Payload. It forms a case index: +4 when the LSG base reference speed LSBPRFES is outside lsg_breakpoint_speed plus or minus LSRFESDC; +2 when the torque derate fuel source code is 15, or 16 with status word 1 bit 9 or 10 set and enabled; +1 when the HSG reference speed state HSRFST is 1, 2, 4 or 5, which also picks HSRFBEDP instead of HSBKRFAE. Its eight cases load the point speeds and fuelings from the derated Jcomm values (e2m 1104) through setJ1939TorqueCurvePoint1AtDeratedIdleFueling, setJ1939TorqueCurvePoints1And3AtDeratedFueling and cm550_calculateGovernorDroopSpeed, or clamp later points to earlier ones. Last it computes the five indicated percent torques (point fueling - CLNTFL) x 25600 / (JCRFEGFL - CLNTFL) limited to 0..32000 into 0x80da1e-0x80da26, copies the point speeds to 0x80da28-0x80da30 and resets the five point fuelings to fuel_demand_maximum. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_updateJ1939EngineConfigurationTorqueCurve (0x20d10). (was vp44_fuelLimitExceedanceStatisticsAccumulator; PR #53 round 97)

roles.role: [CM550] The TPU channel 1 set-up for cam sync type 2. It fills the backup pulse period table (0x80ceae..) with its initial value and sets the next pointer, the per-cam sum 0x80d074 and the per-cylinder average. It then disables channel 1 (CPR1 bits 3-2, CIER and CISR bit 1) and sets CFSR3 bits 7-4 = 0xd, parameter 1 = 0x100, parameter 3 = 0, the parameter 4/5 long = 0, parameter 0 = 0xb, HSQR1 and HSRR1 bits 3-2 = 3 and priority 2. It installs mc68k_tpuChannel1SpeedMeasurementResetInterruptHandler (0x808ee0 = 0x1b4b2), enables the channel 1 interrupt, and clears 0x80d2cc and the long 0x80d2d2.

This one arms the channel unconditionally, fills the table before disabling the channel, installs the handler that only re-arms the channel 0 speed measurement, and clears the two counters. It has no duty cycle and no buffer of its own.

roles.role: [CM550] The TPU channel 1 interrupt handler (it ends in RTE) for cam sync type 1, the cylinder identification (CI) pulse input. mc68k_initializeTpuChannel1BackupSpeedInput (0x1ae22) installs it at 0x808ee0 (move.l at 0x1aec6). It reads the engine position sensor tooth count of the pulse from channel 1 parameter 5's low byte (0xffff1b) into 0x80d2be, clears parameter 4, and reloads the CI timeout counter 0x80d2c2 (misnamed can_tx_message_type) from the byte at 0x807f9d (CI_LOST_COUNT_MAX). A wide (0x807f98) or narrow (0x807f9a) pulse counts the CI tooth count error 0x80d2c0 down, or clears fault word 0 bit 0 when it is already 0. It then compares the tooth counter with the count expected at that pulse's falling edge (0x807f94 / 0x807f96). On a match it sets cam_sync_state / cam_sync_status (0x80d0cc / 0x80d0cd) to 1, clears word 2 bit 11 and counts the crank tooth error 0x80d2bf down. On a mismatch it sets them to 2, resynchronises the tooth counter, and counts 0x80d2bf up to 0x807f9e, then sets word 0 bit 0 and word 2 bit 11. A pulse of neither width counts 0x80d2c0 up to 0x807f9f, then sets word 0 bit 0. Last it calls mc68k_resetSpeedMeasurementMode0 and the empty hook 0xc87e, and clears CISR bit 1.
roles.discriminator: It is the only channel 1 handler that classifies the pulse width (wide or narrow) and sets the cam sync state. 0x1b30a captures backup periods, and 0x1b4b2 only re-arms channel 0. It monitors no duty cycle.
roles.cm848_counterpart: counterpart: mpc555_handleCamSignalInterrupt @ 0x457d0 (the TPU-A channel 1 cam signal handler that runs cam_sync_state, with a different algorithm)

roles.role: [CM550] The TPU channel 0 interrupt handler (it ends in RTE) for engine_position_signal_configuration 2. mc68k_initializeTpuChannel0MissingToothInputMode2 (0x1a47c) installs it at 0x808edc (move.l at 0x1a510). It reads TPU channel 15 parameter 6 (0xfffffc): the high byte goes to the PMM error type CKSYERTY (0x80d293) and the low byte to the error tooth CKSYERTT (0x80d292). Error type 0xc0 sets cam_sync_state and cam_sync_status to 0 (no sync); any other type sets them to 2 (lost sync). It then calls mc68k_configureTpuChannelsForSpeedMeasurementMode (0x34a82) and clears CISR bit 0.
roles.discriminator: The configuration 0 channel 0 handler 0x19c88 only calls 0x34a82. The configuration 1 handler 0x19f82 tests error types 0 / 0xff and does more. This one turns the PMM error type into sync state 0 or 2. It stores no fuel and no timing buffer.

roles.role: [CM550] Step 1 of the crank entry set-up in cm550_engineModeTransitionHandler (0x17d2a, bsr.w at 0x17d52). The set-up runs on STOPPED to CRANKING or RUNNING to REENTRY. It computes the crank initial fuel 0x80d0a6 (e2m 105E +E CKIIFL, no row) and crank_initial_fuel_break_speed 0x80d0b2 (105E +1A CKIIFLES) from the filtered coolant temperature 0x80a336. Fault word 2 (0x806004) bit 0 or 1 set and enabled (0x806ac0), or coolant below CKCDCLTP (0x807eee), selects the cold values CKCDCLFL (0x807ef8) and CKCDCLES (0x807efc). Coolant above CKHTCLTP (0x807eec) selects the hot values CKHTCLFL (0x807ef6) and CKHTCLES (0x807efa). Between the two temperatures both outputs are interpolated linearly.

Only this step sets the initial fuel and its break speed from coolant. It involves no frictional load and no torque.

roles.role: [CM550] Step 3 of the crank entry set-up (bsr.w at 0x17d5a in 0x17d2a). It compares CKEXESSW (0x803f8a, e2m 1254 +3C, EEPROM mirror, no row) with 1. On 1 it stores CKCNEXES (0x807eea, 105F +0) in crank_exit_speed (0x80d0ac, 105E +14 CKEXES); otherwise it stores the LSG reference LSRF (0x80db02).

It is step 3 of cm848_processColdStartAdjustment (bl at 0x1bfa0), under the same state-entry condition. Both rows take the shared name. roles.role: [CM550] It sets point 1 of the J1939 engine configuration torque curve (PGN 65251, e2m 1102). When algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal bit 0x40 (low_speed_governor_droop_enable) is set and the droop slope 0x80daf4 (1065 +16 LSDPSE) is nonzero, the point 1 speed 0x80da38 (+22 JCTQRPP1) = LSRF - slope x derated idle fueling 0x808168 (1104 +A JCDQFLIS) / 167, clamped to 0. Otherwise the point 1 speed = LSRF. The point 1 fueling 0x80da42 (+2C JCTQFLP1) = 0x808168. Callers: bsr.s at 0xfa7e in setJ1939TorqueCurvePoints1And3AtDeratedFueling (0xfa68), and bsr.w at 0xfc52 / 0xfcac in cases 2 and 3 of the torque curve builder 0xfb26.
roles.discriminator: It writes only point 1 (speed and fueling). 0xfa68 also does point 3, and the builder does all points. No VP44 and no state machine are involved.
roles.cm848_counterpart: TWIN: cm848_setJ1939TorqueCurvePoint1AtDeratedIdleFueling @ 0x20b84 tests the same bit 0x40 (rlwinm 25,25), uses 0x40aeda (named governor_integrator_correction_term, no e2m row), divides by 167 and clamps to 0, with the same 1102 +22 / +2C and 1104 +A records. Its callers are 0x20bfc and cases 2 and 3 of 0x20d10. It already has the name, so drop the prefix in CM848 and use the same name in CM550.

roles.role: [CM550] The J1939 engine configuration torque curve builder (PGN 65251, e2m 1102). Its only call is a jsr at 0x33228 in buildPgn65251EngineConfiguration1Payload (0x3320e). It forms a mode index. +4 when the LSG base reference 0x803b9e is outside LSRF +/- 0x80817c. +2 for FUELING_STATE 15 (altitude derate), or 16 (air fuel control derate) with fault word 1 bit 9 or 10 enabled; the 4D interpolation factor at 0x4000 then picks the low or high power point 2. +1 when the speed limit source 0x80d644 is 1, 2, 4 or 5, which also selects the droop reference 0x800182. Cases 0-7 (jump table at 0xfc2e) load the derated points through 0xfa06, 0xfa68 and cm550_calculateGovernorDroopSpeed, or clamp point 3 to point 1 and point 5 to point 2. For each point it then computes (fueling - zero-torque fueling) x 0x6400 / (peak fueling - zero-torque fueling), limited to 32000. It copies the five speeds into the determined speed words and resets the five working fuelings to fuel_demand_maximum.
roles.discriminator: This is the builder that holds the case table; the 0xfa06 / 0xfa68 helpers each set one or two points. It touches no VP44 and accumulates no exceedance statistics.
roles.cm848_counterpart: counterpart: cm848_updateJ1939EngineConfigurationTorqueCurve @ 0x20d10 (bl from buildPgn65251EngineConfiguration1Payload at 0x1b3b8) has the same frame. CM848 also counts speed limit source 12 toward +1, divides each point by its own reference fueling (1102 +40..+48), and caches the calculated fuelings, so it is not a twin.

roles.role: [CM550] The lamp driver open / short circuit check, run every 50 ms by cm550_updateLampOutputsAndCheckLampDriverFaults (0x24804, jsr at 0x2480a) after cm550_applyLampRequestsToOutputs. It runs while bit 0 of 0x80bcce (DSKYSWSS key switch, e2m 000E +0) is set. For each of the seven lamp drivers (bits 0, 1, 2, 6, 4, 5, 3) it compares the driver output bits 0x80bd02 with the driver feedback 0x80bd08. The output bits are e2m 000E +34 LCLP01FB..LCLP07FB, written by mc68k_ioDriverStrobeHandler with the overrides merged in (the row is misnamed status_of_the_water_in_fuel_lamp_output_on_off). The feedback is a byte read from the CS2 device at 0xffd004. When the bits agree it clears both debounce counters, and it clears a latched fault bit (one whose first-occurrence bit is not set) after the clear count _DAT_000611ca. A mismatch with the output off counts one counter up to _DAT_000611c8 and then sets one fault bit; with the output on, it counts the other counter and sets the other bit. The fault bits are in system error status words 7 and 8, with their first-occurrence flags.
roles.discriminator: It is the only reader of 0x80bd02 against the feedback 0x80bd08, and it handles only lamp driver faults. It processes no diagnostic state machine. CM848's diagnosticMainStateProcessor is an unrelated function (the fault scan), so this one needs its own prefixed name.

It is not CM848 0x1d9b8.

roles.role: [CM848] diagnosticMainStateProcessor, checked: a 20 ms step of cm848_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase1 (bl at 0xb9ec). It rebuilds system_switch_status and system_switch_status_2 from switch and output request bits. When key_on_hour_meter has moved more than 24 counts it runs cm848_countDownPreviouslyActiveFaults.

roles.role: [CM848] hpcr_cbdFillAccelerationBuffers, called from hpcr_processEngineSyncPulses (0x44fa8, the TPU-A channel 11 handler; bl at 0x451a8). It runs while cbd_enable_flag or misfire_monitor_speed_buffer_enable_flag is 1, with crank sync state 4. At the start tooth (cylinder_balance_start_tooth, or the misfire monitor start tooth) it arms the capture (cylinder_event_seq_counter 0). Then, at each cylinder event matched through TPU-A channel 12 parameter 7, it stores (TPU-A channel 14 32-bit capture - previous) >> 2 into cylinder_balance_acceleration_buffer_1..n. Without sync it sets the counter to 0xff.

It sets the stop compensation flag from the stop compensation table, the speed change and the engine state. It forms the Fourier components of the acceleration buffers (4, 6 or 8 events), removes the learned dynamic compensation, and picks the trim patterns from the reference-vector projections (stack array local_48). It learns cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_cal within limits and gates.

It copies cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_cal (EEPROM) for cylinder_event_count_max cylinders into 0x3fb580, the power-up trims that limit mode 1 restores (read back at the trim limit check). Despite the name, it touches no filter state.

The index of the largest entry is stored in cylinder_balance_trim_index_1 (0x809260); the max loop uses a2 = 0x8002b0, step 4, and 5 compares against [0]. It has no e2m record. The row type 'dword' and the name load_trending_table_2_ptr are wrong.

It fills the 23 entries of the two 16-entry channel handler tables that have no handler of their own: ROM 0x583ae for mpc555_tpuBInterruptDispatcher (TPU-B channels 0, 3-8, 10-13 and 15) and ROM 0x583ee for mpc555_tpuAInterruptDispatcher (TPU-A channels 2-5, 7-9 and 12-15). The dispatchers call the entry after clearing the channel's interrupt status bit, so an interrupt of such a channel does nothing. Some of these channels still run a TPU function (mpc555_driveOutputLineHigh sets TPU-B channel 4 to function 0xF), they only have no interrupt handler. It has no bl caller. (was cm848_emptyStubFunction8; PR #53 round 97)
verdicts.own_role: Empty (4e800020). The default entry of the TPU-B (0x583ae) and TPU-A (0x583ee) channel interrupt handler tables: 12 + 11 = 23 pointers. The dispatchers 0x55d2c / 0x55de4 call it with lwzx + blrl after clearing the CISR bit.
verdicts.reason: The name and the channel lists are right: 23 pointers at 0x583ae-0x5842a; lis / addi at 0x55dbc -> 0x583ae and at 0x55e74 -> 0x583ee. The describer's 12 / 11 counts (13 / 10) were wrong. The plate's 'an interrupt of a channel without a function does nothing' is false: TPU-B channel 4 is a stub entry, yet mpc555_driveOutputLineHigh sets its CFSR1 nibble to 0xF (0x5009c-0x500b0), and TPU-B CFSR1 / CFSR2 are written for several stub channels. The comment is amended to 'without an interrupt handler of its own'. The same fact rules out the describer's 'Unused' name.

verdicts.own_role: Per engine sync pulse (bl 0x451a8 in hpcr_processEngineSyncPulses). While cylinder balancing or the misfire speed buffer is enabled and crank sync state is 4: at the start tooth (TPU-A ch0 PARAM4 low byte) with no capture running, latches the ch12 PARAM7 byte (0x3fb57c) and the ch14 capture (0x3fb578). Then stores (capture - previous) >> 2 into cylinder_balance_acceleration_buffer_n per event up to cylinder_event_count_max. Out of sync: counter 0xff.
verdicts.reason: The decompiled body and the data refs (stb 0x42c58, stw 0x42c68, lbz 0x42c9c, stb 0x42cf4) match the plate. It is the only writer of the 81B0 CBD_Accel_Buffer words. The hpcr_ prefix is kept, matching hpcr_filterCylinderBalanceFueling.

verdicts.final_comment: The cylinder balancing trim calculation, called from executiveFrameInterruptHandler (bl at 0xc2cc). It runs while cylinder_balance_enable_flag or misfire_monitor_speed_buffer_enable_flag is 1. It looks up the stop compensation (CBD_Stop_Compensation_Table by engine speed and cylinder_balance_filtered_fueling) and sets cylinder_balance_stop_compensation_flag from it, the engine speed change and the engine state. Once cylinder_event_seq_counter reaches cylinder_event_count_max, it forms the Fourier components from cylinder_balance_acceleration_buffer_1.. for 4, 6 or 8 cylinders, removes the learned dynamics compensation and picks the trim pattern from the projections on the reference vectors. While cylinder_balance_compensation_enable_cal is 1 and misfire_monitor_cylinder_balance_suspend_flag is 0, it adds the trim steps into cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_cal. When a trim leaves cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_minimum..cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_maximum (cylinder_balance_trim_limits_exceeded_flag), cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_limit_mode 0 takes the step back, 1 restores the trims from cylinder_balance_power_up_fueling_trims and 2 sets them to 0. Counterpart of CM550 cm550_calculateCylinderBalanceTrims. (was hpcr_cbdCalculateCylinderTrims; PR #53 round 97)
verdicts.own_role: Cylinder balancing trim calculation (bl 0xc2cc, executiveFrameInterruptHandler). Stop compensation flag, Fourier components of the acceleration buffers (4 / 6 / 8 cylinders), dynamic compensation removal, the six reference projections (local_48, [3..5] = -[0..2]) and max search, trim learning, then the limit check and the limit mode action.
verdicts.reason: The name is right: the only reader of the full buffer set and the only adder into cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_cal; 'cbd' is spelled out. The plate said 'limit mode 1 restores them' with no condition. The decompiled code restores from 0x3fb580 only when cylinder_balance_trim_limits_exceeded_flag is 1. Mode 0 subtracts the step and mode 2 zeroes the trims. The add itself is gated by cylinder_balance_compensation_enable_cal and misfire_monitor_cylinder_balance_suspend_flag. The comment is amended to say so. CM550's six-point method differs, so counterpart.

e2m 1067 +2 LSCIRF 'COLD IDLE LSG REFERENCE SPEED'. The only user is cm550_calculateLowSpeedGovernorColdIdleSpeed (a2 at 0x2661a). Engine stopped: LSCIRFSR when coolant < LSCICLTP, else 0. Running, once LSCITMLM is reached or the engine is warm: ramps down by LSCIRMRT to 0. It is a floor that LSDSRFRP 0x80db06 is raised to unless the flags 12 bit 0x4000 override applies. Not an adder. Word accesses; CM848 has no 1067 block. The name fits CM848's low_speed_governor_cold_idle_* family.

Otherwise it sends a 7-byte frame on PGN 61184 to the requester (0x42, the ID, the 4 address bytes; jsr 0x103ba) and returns 0xff. That is the same behaviour as CM848's cm848_handleJ1939GetAddressByParameterIdService, whose 0x41 member has this name; CM848 is unchanged. Not in the batch list, but the code proves it.
